title: beseen.so: be seen by humans and agents
excerpt: See which questions your buyers ask ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity, who gets named instead of you, and what your pages are missing. Beseen writes the fix.
content_html:
Beseen asks the questions your buyers ask ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity, and shows you who gets named instead of you. One check, and you have the list, your Google position beside each one, and the page that closes it.

One free report. No account, no card. Plans from $29 a month.

Who gets named, every week. Where you rank, every fortnight.

  • Google
  • ChatGPT
  • Claude
  • Perplexity
  • Gemini

Why Beseen

Some tools tell you what is broken. Others write pages nobody checks. Beseen does both, then shows you which prompts moved. The prompts your customers actually ask, checked as often as you ask for, and the keywords you rank for pulled beside them, each position coming round about once a fortnight. You see where a competitor gets named and you do not, and the page that should have won it.

Get my free report

Your customers ask an assistant before they ask you. Beseen tells you what it says back. Notes on rankings and AI answers works through why the two do not track each other.

ChatGPT

Every one of those prompts, run against ChatGPT on the cadence you set. We log which brands it names and whether you are one of them.

Claude

The same prompts against Claude. Different answers, different sources, often a different winner.

Perplexity

Perplexity names its sources on screen, so you see the exact pages beating you and why they win.

Gemini

The engine sitting closest to Google, where the same customers are already searching.

What the report shows

How many of the questions your buyers ask named you, how many named a rival instead, and how many named nobody at all. Then the work that closes the gap, written out ready to paste in. All of that arrives on the first check. What your rewrite moved arrives on the ones after it.

Get my free report

How it works

See where you rank and where you are cited, fix the pages losing both, then check again. The gap becomes a rewrite list. The rewrite list becomes finished pages. Then every prompt and every position runs again, so you find out what actually moved.

Know which prompts you're losing

Know which prompts send customers to a competitor and which name nobody at all. You enter a domain and nothing else. Beseen finds your competitors, the keywords you already rank for, and the prompts your customers ask, then runs them on the cadence you set. What a check actually runs.

Get my free report

What you get

Rewrites where you can still win, new pages where you cannot, proof either way. Positions 4 to 15 get rewritten. Positions 16 to 50 get new sections. Anything past that gets a new page. Beseen never touches your site: you get the copy and a prompt for your own coding agent, and you decide what ships.

  • Only the pages that can move

    Positions 1 to 3 stay untouched. 4 to 15 get a new title, intro and H2 structure.

  • From gap to the page that fixes it

    Comparison and alternatives pages are what assistants cite. Beseen names the ones you are missing, then writes them.

  • The weekly re-check

    Every search re-runs on the schedule you set, across the assistants you picked and Google alongside them, so you see the before and the after.

Why it works

A list of prompts you lose, each with the page that wins it back. Not a visibility score to interpret. Named gaps, the fix for each one, and a weekly check that says whether it worked.

  • Named gaps, not scores

    You see the exact prompts where a competitor gets named and you don't. Not a visibility score. A list you can act on.

  • Fixes, not a to-do list

    Every gap leaves with its fix attached: the page that closes it and the prompt that writes it. Not a list to go away and think about.

  • Citations weekly, rankings on rotation

    Whether the assistants name you, re-checked as often as you asked for. Your Google positions come round in the same run, each one about once a fortnight.

  • Proof the fix worked

    Every re-check compares against your first one, so you can see which page changed which prompt, and which one did nothing.

Every feature included. You choose the coverage.

There is no plan that withholds the rewrites, or the competitor list, or the re-check that proves a fix landed. Everybody gets all of it. What you pick is how many sites we watch, how many searches on each, which assistants we ask and how often. It starts at $29 a month.

How many websites?

How many searches should Beseen track on each?

The questions your buyers actually type. Beseen finds them for you, so this is a ceiling rather than a homework assignment.

Which assistants should we ask?

Each one answers differently, and each one gets asked every search you track.

Google is on every run, at every price.

How often should we check?

Weekly suits most sites. Assistants vary their answers run to run, so checking daily mostly buys you sharper noise.

$29per month

1 website, 30 tracked searches, 1 assistant, weekly. Billed monthly, cancel any time.

Every feature is included. The rewrites, the article briefs, the competitor list and the re-checks are in this price and in every other one. What changes as you move the dials is how much gets watched, not how much of the product you are allowed.

See where you stand first.

A free report on your own domain, before you pay for anything.

No account. No card.

Find out where you rank, and who AI names.

One free report, with no account and no card, is enough to see the questions you lose, who gets named on them instead of you, and whether your site is readable by an agent at all. Moving an answer takes three to four weeks, so that part starts the day you apply the fix and finishes well after.

See who the assistants name

About 10 questions your customers actually ask, put to the assistants and to Google, with every citation recorded and the answer each one gave.

Get the page that closes it

Rewrites for the pages that already rank, briefs for the pages you are missing. You apply them, and the same prompts get asked again on your next check.

5 surfaces
Your Google positions on every run, plus whichever of ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude you pick.

From $29 a month
One site, thirty searches, one assistant and your Google rankings, checked every week.

150 searches versus 5
Searches we track at $214/mo, against 5 on Ahrefs Brand Radar at $199/mo.

One free report
No account, no card, and the page behind your worst gap rewritten for you.
